title: Waiting for async UI: findBy and waitFor

slides.say: Your component fetches data, then shows it. If the test looks right away, the data isn't there yet.
Use find by. It's get by plus waiting: it keeps checking until the element appears, or gives up after one second by default.
For anything else, use wait for. It runs your callback again and again until it stops throwing.

slides.text: waitFor retries only when the callback THROWS. Returning false doesn't make it wait.
slides.say: Careful: wait for retries only when the callback throws. Returning false counts as success, so put an expect inside.
